requirements.requirement: The system must include a 'phase' field in each clinical trial object returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must include a 'phase_score' field in each clinical trial object returned by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must populate 'phase_score' using the output of the phase-to-score mapping logic from clinical_trials_service.
The system must ensure that the 'phase_score' value conforms to the schema defined in clinical_trials_models.
The system must preserve all existing clinical trial response fields without modification when adding 'phase_score'.
The system must return both 'phase' and 'phase_score' for every trial where phase data is available.
The system must set 'phase_score' to a valid default value when the 'phase' field is 'N/A' or missing.
The system must not fail the entire clinical trial response if a single trial has an invalid or unmapped phase value.
The system must include all clinical trials in the response even if 'phase_score' computation fails for some entries.
The system must ensure that the response structure remains compatible with evaluate_care_facade consumers after adding 'phase_score'.
The system must serialize 'phase_score' as a numeric value in the API response.
The system must ensure that the order of clinical trials in the response is unchanged by the addition of 'phase_score'.
The system must log an internal warning when phase-to-score mapping fails for a trial without exposing the error to the API consumer.
The system must handle null or empty phase values by returning a consistent 'phase' and default 'phase_score' pair.
